title: Anthropic has its own AI-powered office suite now
slides: Anthropic's office suite: threat to Microsoft or Google?
Its AI writes documents, slides, and spreadsheets directly
But it only runs on Claude, locking users in
Teams already on Claude can try it today
Test one real workflow before your rivals do
thread_text:
1. The AI office suite war

Anthropic now writes documents, slides, and spreadsheets directly inside its own app. Microsoft and Google should be paying attention.

2. But there's a catch

It only runs on Claude, so every file you create locks you deeper into their ecosystem. Convenience comes with a price.

3. Are you already in?

If your team uses Claude today, you can test the office suite right now. No waitlist, no extra cost.

4. First-mover advantage

Early adopters will find the quirks and workarounds before competitors do. That knowledge becomes a real edge.

5. Test one workflow today

Pick a real document or deck you need this week and build it with Claude. If it saves less time than it costs, you'll know fast.
